<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
import pandas as pd

# Read the input file
input_path = 'outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv'
output_report_path = 'outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv'
output_matrix_path = 'outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv'

# Read the input CSV
df = pd.read_csv(input_path)

# Identify indicator columns (exclude city_id, city_name, year)
indicator_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col not in ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']]

# Calculate missingness per indicator
missing_info = []
for col in indicator_cols:
    missing_count = df[col].isna().sum()
    total_count = len(df)
    missing_rate = missing_count / total_count if total_count > 0 else 0
    kept = 1 if missing_rate <= 0.30 else 0
    missing_info.append({
        'indicator': col,
        'missing_count': missing_count,
        'missing_rate': missing_rate,
        'kept': kept
    })

# Create the missingness report
report_df = pd.DataFrame(missing_info)
report_df.to_csv(output_report_path, index=False)

# Filter the matrix to keep only indicators with missing_rate <= 0.30
selected_indicators = [col for col in indicator_cols if df[col].isna().sum() / len(df) <= 0.30]
selected_df = df[['city_id', 'city_name', 'year'] + selected_indicators]
selected_df.to_csv(output_matrix_path, index=False)
</solution_file>

import pandas as pd

input_path = 'outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv'

output_matrix_path = 'outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv'

# Read the input CSV
df = pd.read_csv(input_path)

# Identify indicator columns (exclude city_id, city_name, year)
indicator_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col not in ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']]

# Calculate missingness per indicator
missing_info = []
for col in indicator_cols:
    missing_count = df[col].isna().sum()
    total_count = len(df)
    missing_rate = missing_count / total_count if total_count > 0 else 0
    kept = 'True' if missing_rate <= 0.30 else 'False'
    missing_info.append({
        'indicator': col,
        'missing_count': missing_count,
        'missing_rate': missing_rate,
        'kept': kept
    })

# Create the missingness report

report_df.to_csv(output_report_path, index=False)

# Filter the matrix to keep only indicators with missing_rate <= 0.30
